subject: design/existing-repo-onboarding-v2
statement: the plan is one closed schema-versioned record, `adoption-plan/v1`, stored in the engine's system namespace (no collision with the adopter's tree), rendered human-readable for review (`design-brainstorm:…#D-2`; AP-5). It carries, per path, the class the engine assigns it, and — after apply — the resolved undo-data. The operator commits it with the adoption (no engine-authored commit, DINV-4).
